CLI command that prints a block of text somebody else wrote must write it with Console.Out, never AnsiConsole. Spectre falls back to an 80-column width whenever stdout is not a TTY, which is every call an orchestrator window, a courier, or a script makes, so AnsiConsole.WriteLine rewraps the block and the reader can no longer trust its line structure.
